evals.prompt: Write a Solidity contract that schedules native fungible token creation through the HSS system contract (HIP-756), calling the HTS precompile at 0x167 via scheduleNative.
evals.expected_output: A contract inheriting HederaScheduleService that schedules HTS token creation with scheduleNative and checks HederaResponseCodes.SUCCESS.

checks.name: uses-schedule-native
checks.description: Uses scheduleNative to schedule the HTS call

checks.name: encodes-token-create
checks.description: Encodes a createFungibleToken call in the scheduled payload

evals.prompt: Write a Solidity contract that schedules an arbitrary future contract call using scheduleCall (HIP-1215). It must check hasScheduleCapacity first and handle the non-reverting failure pattern.
evals.expected_output: A HederaScheduleService contract that checks hasScheduleCapacity, calls scheduleCall, and reverts when rc is not SUCCESS or schedule address is zero.

checks.name: uses-schedule-call
checks.description: Uses scheduleCall for HIP-1215 generalized scheduling

checks.name: handles-non-reverting-failure
checks.description: Checks response code because scheduleCall does not revert on failure
checks.rubric: The output checks the scheduleCall response code and rejects failure (for example rc != HederaResponseCodes.SUCCESS or scheduleAddr == address(0))

checks.name: uses-expiry-and-gas
checks.description: Passes target, expiry, gas limit, and call data to scheduleCall
checks.rubric: The output calls scheduleCall with target, expiry, gas limit, and encoded call data
